_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_pd#4, and a falsification of its Signal. The rule holds but the failure is loud, not silent: BIN_SIZE_LOWER_BOUND below INTERACTION_HORIZON aborts in the SPHPeridynamic constructor with 'Peridynamic INTERACTION_HORIZON must be smaller than BIN_SIZE_LOWER_BOUND!' from particle/src/interaction/4C_particle_interaction_sph_peridynamic.cpp line 60, before any time step and before the bond count is ever printed. There is therefore no degraded neighbour count to observe, and no 'neighbor_count' diagnostic exists in 4C at all. The guard is horizon <= bin size, so bin == horizon is accepted despite the message saying 'smaller than', and gives the same 1512 bonds as the upstream setting — the third arm pins that. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Peridynamic INTERACTION_HORIZON must be smaller than BIN_SIZE_LOWER_BOUND!
Number of initialized peridynamic bonds on this proc: 1512

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: give the third arm a bin size above the horizon. The abort and its file/line vanish, BIN2_BOND_COUNT_LINES becomes 1 and EXIT_BIN2 becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
